title: JDN Launches CSR Program Bank for Education, Health, and Environment
excerpt: Program bank helps companies choose initiatives ready to be developed into impactful CSR programs.
content: Jejak Dampak Nusantara launched a CSR Program Bank to make it easier for companies to choose initiatives that match their needs and goals.
This program bank covers various categories such as education, health, environment, and economic empowerment.
Each program comes with clear impact indicators, so companies can see measurable results from their social investments.
With this approach, it is hoped that more companies will engage in sustainable development in Indonesia.
highlight: Every CSR program must have measurable and accountable impact.

title: School Nutrition Kitchen Promotes Community-Based Stunting Education
excerpt: School nutrition program developed with child status monitoring, parent education, and regular reporting.
content: Jejak Dampak Nusantara believes that impact stories must be conveyed with easy-to-understand data and verifiable evidence.
In every program, the team compiles needs, indicators, documentation, and field learnings so donors and partners can see changes more clearly.
This model helps social programs not stop at ceremonies, but move towards sustainable impact that can be developed in other regions.
Going forward, JDN will continue to update program reports, beneficiary stories, and public materials so the community can follow progress transparently.
highlight: Every small action leaves a real, verifiable, and documented impact trail.

title: Solar Panels Open Learning Access for Schools with Limited Electricity
excerpt: Clean energy helps schools maintain learning activities and basic operations in areas with limited electricity.
content: Limited electricity access is often a major obstacle in the teaching and learning process in remote areas.
With solar panel installation, schools can run learning activities better, including the use of digital devices.
This program also provides training to local operators to ensure the sustainability of facility operations.
It is hoped that this initiative can be replicated in more schools that need clean energy access.
highlight: Clean energy opens wider educational access for children in remote areas.

title: Volunteer Impact Day: How Company Employees Engage Directly in Impact
excerpt: One-day volunteer activities are designed to be short, safe, and have clear impact indicators.
content: Volunteer Impact Day is a program designed to engage company employees in meaningful social activities.
This activity is designed to be short but have measurable impact, making it suitable for employees with busy schedules.
Companies can choose activity themes that match their values and CSR focus.
Each activity comes with documentation and impact reports that can be shared with stakeholders.
highlight: Employee engagement in social activities increases ownership and job satisfaction.

title: Why Donation Transparency and Impact Reports Matter for Public Trust
excerpt: Donors and partners need easily verifiable evidence, not just ceremonial documentation.
content: Trust is the main foundation in every philanthropic activity and corporate social responsibility.
Transparency in donation reporting and program impact is key to building that trust.
A good impact report should include clear data, complete documentation, and honest analysis.
With transparency, donors and partners can see that their contributions truly make positive changes.
highlight: Transparency is not just an obligation, but a long-term investment for public trust.

title: Dream Trail Scholarship Opens Education Access for Vulnerable Students
excerpt: Scholarship program provides school fee support, mentoring, and career preparation for students from vulnerable families.
content: Dream Trail Scholarship exists to help students from vulnerable families get better access to education.
This program not only provides school fee support but also mentoring and career guidance.
Each scholarship recipient gets personal mentoring to ensure they can complete their education well.
Going forward, this program will be expanded to more regions to reach more students in need.
highlight: Education is the key to breaking the cycle of poverty and opening a better future.

title: Empowered Posyandu Improves Maternal and Child Health in Semarang
excerpt: Posyandu revitalization with modern measuring tools, cadre training, and mother-child education to improve community health.
content: Empowered Posyandu exists to revitalize posyandu with more modern equipment and better cadre training.
This program focuses on improving maternal and child health through education and regular check-ups.
Posyandu cadres receive intensive training to provide higher quality services.
As a result, posyandu visit rates increased and maternal-child health in the area improved.
highlight: Maternal and child health is the foundation for a healthier and stronger generation.

title: Green Village Creates Sustainable Environment in Bali
excerpt: Waste bank, compost, greening, and community-based climate education to create a sustainable environment.
content: Green Village is a community empowerment program to create a cleaner and more sustainable environment.
This program includes waste management, composting, greening, and climate change education.
Residents are actively involved in every activity to ensure program sustainability.
As a result, the environment becomes cleaner and the community is more aware of the importance of preserving nature.
highlight: A healthy environment is the best legacy for future generations.
